name: Star Health and Allied Insurance
summary: The insurer confirmed a malicious cyberattack after a hacker group leaked policyholder data, including health records and claims, through Telegram chatbots.

name: AIIMS New Delhi
summary: The hospital's eHospital server went down and digital services ran in manual mode while the NIC team suspected ransomware.

name: C-Edge Technologies
summary: NPCI cut off this technology provider to cooperative and regional rural banks after a possible ransomware attack, then restored it after an audit.

name: Tata Technologies
summary: A ransomware attack hit some company IT assets and forced a temporary suspension of some services while client delivery kept running.
